items.stem: The committee ______ divided in their opinions on the proposal.
items.sol: committee 作“委员会成员”讲时用复数谓语（英式习惯），divided in their opinions 说明这里指人。

items.stem: The word "meticulous" is closest in meaning to ______.
items.sol: meticulous = 一丝不苟的、极其细致的，常与 attention to detail 搭配。

items.stem: Not until he failed the exam ______ the importance of hard work.
items.sol: Not until 置于句首引起部分倒装，主句用助动词提前：did he realize。

items.stem: The new regulation is subject ______ approval by the board.
items.sol: be subject to = 受……支配/须经……，to 是介词，后接名词。

items.stem: The number of students in our department ______ (be) increasing year by year.
items.sol: the number of + 复数名词作主语，谓语用单数；a number of 才用复数。

items.stem: "Deteriorate" most nearly means ______.
items.sol: deteriorate = 恶化、变坏，名词形式 deterioration。

items.stem: If I ______ you, I would take the offer.
items.sol: 与现在事实相反的虚拟语气，be 动词一律用 were。

items.stem: This is the book ______ changed my life.
items.sol: 先行词是物，关系代词用 which 或 that；what 不能引导定语从句。

items.stem: The outcome was ______: everyone had predicted it.
His answer was so ______ that nobody knew what he meant.
Whether we go ahead depends ______ the budget.
______ the report, he submitted it to the board.
items.sol: 完成在先，用现在分词的完成式作状语。

items.stem: Only when the war ended ______ return home.
items.sol: only + 状语从句置于句首，主句用部分倒装。

items.stem: The report gives a ______ overview of the whole field.
The medicine helped ______ the pain.
______ of cost, the plan is acceptable.
This view is ______ among young researchers.
The auditors ______ every transaction carefully.
Each of the students ______ a copy of the syllabus.
items.sol: each of + 复数名词作主语，谓语用单数。

items.stem: Her explanation sounds ______, but it lacks evidence.
Lack of sleep can ______ your ability to concentrate.
The success is largely attributed ______ hard work.
The paragraph is ______; the same idea appears three times.
Is it ______ to finish the project within a week?
The more you practise, ______ you become.
items.sol: the + 比较级，the + 比较级：越……越……。

items.stem: Curiosity is ______ to scientific research.
